author: Yffe
content:
FIXED — commit 5d0bc8cb (thermite-lower/src/l1.rs, +13/-2 net production; tests -1; doc +1/-1).

ROOT CAUSE: the bytes_eq L1 exec twin ran the window-bounds guard BEFORE the empty-window case. At n=0, ai=5 > len=2 the guard returned false, but the spec body REQ-18 n<=0 arm is true unconditionally — no index is accessed.

FIX REQ-20 SAME-value: emit the n<=0 arm first, before the guard. n is u64 so n==0 equals the spec arm.
  BEFORE first stmt: let ai_u: usize = ai as usize;  ...then  if ai_u + n_u > a.data.len() || bi_u + n_u > b.data.len() { return false; }
  AFTER  first stmt: if n == 0 { return true; }       ...then the unchanged window guard
The window guard now fires only when n > 0 an index is genuinely accessed; the certified ens bytes_eq(result, result, 5, 5, 0) now runs CLEAN in the built binary.

No new pub API R-DEFER-1 n/a, twin body only. No contract weakened R-DEFER-9: the twin now matches MORE of the spec, not less. No golden carries the twin text the pin lowers it at runtime; none updated. The two-commit ceremony collapsed to one: the only doc change is the authorized illustrative-sketch rider offset 8 to 7, which the plan places in commit 1; no separate golden/pin bumps were produced.

AUTHORIZED RIDER applied: .design/basis/07-strings.md render_frame sketch offset 8 to 7 AC-15 + shipped proven editor pin.

Un-ignore'd thermite-lower/tests/divergence_bytes_eq_l1_empty_window.rs -> permanent regression coverage.

GAUNTLET integer counts:
  build --workspace: ok
  test -p thermite-lower: pin 1 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored; full suite ok
  clippy -p thermite-lower --all-targets -D warnings: clean
  fmt --check: clean
  test -p forge --test editor_runs: 9 passed, 0 failed
  test --workspace grep -cE FAILED error-bracket: 0

Hand back for acto-critic re-audit.
